scope: Bound paginated EcocreditService result reads at the database query level

implementation.project_queries: Select only the requested active or class-associated location IDs before project metadata hydration
implementation.ordering: created_at DESC, id DESC for manager pages; location ID for project pages
implementation.page_limit: Validated request limit, default 100 and maximum 500
implementation.total: Separate COUNT query with the same list filters

data_access.loopback: Enabled gRPC service with synthetic rows and mocked database factory

limitations: COUNT(*) and large OFFSET values may still require scanning many records; bounded page materialization does not bound total database work.
The count and page are separate statements, and subsequent RPC pages use new result sets, so concurrent writes can change totals or shift offset pages.
Authentication and tenant scope, TLS, REST parity, live runtime behavior, and MAN-CAP-064 remain open.
